method: Agent title triage across all 2175 exact venue/title groups, followed by targeted reading of returned descriptions and lineups for suspicious listings. Repeated occurrences grouped for review, counted separately in show totals. No production classifier run and no provider-model API call. These are content audit judgments, not independently verified ground truth.
limitations: Flags are a conservative triage set, not an exhaustive false-positive rate; remaining listings are not certified comedy.
No description or lineup is not evidence of non-comedy.
Public lineups do not expose blocked identities or parent links, so blocked-only and blocked-only-with-parents rates cannot be calculated from this endpoint.
A non-comedy event at a venue does not establish that comedy never occurs there.
Movie screenings, workshops, mixed variety and drag require separate format decisions; do not blanket exclude them.
Offset pagination is not a transactional snapshot, though all six pages reported the same total and all 2886 IDs were unique.
This assesses published-content precision; cannot measure missed comedy/recall or substitute for the fresh validation required by TASK-4160.
This audit exposes these listings to the agent. Do not subsequently treat these judgments as blind independent validation labels.

counterexamples.name: THIRSTY THURSDAY
counterexamples.description: THIRSTY THURSDAY is your midweek fix for stand-up done right — a rotating lineup of rising talent and touring pros who bring the jokes, the timing, and the energy. As the weekend gets closer, expect bold personalities and unexpected punchlines that keep the room loose and laughing. Grab a drink, kick back, and let the comedy carry you into the weekend. Whether you're closing out a long week or just getting started, this is the show built for it — big laughs, memorable moments, and a night out that hits every time. Only at Comix Roadhouse. Comix Roadhouse isn't just where the laughs happen — it's a destination in its own right. The venue earned Connecticut Magazine's 2026 Best of Connecticut statewide win for Best Casino Casual Dining, along with OpenTable's 2026 Diners' Choice Award, cementing its place as one of the region's premier spots to eat, drink, and be entertained. OCT 1 - SAINTS & SINNERS IS BACK — BIGGER AND BETTER THAN EVER. Celebrating ONE YEAR of no-holds-barred Thirsty Thursday Comedy with a lineup packed with the biggest killers of the year. Hosted by comedic genius MOOSE HILL and headlined by the hilarious RYAN BRAUTH. -- This showcase is curated by Connecticut’s own CORY ALBERT, recipient of Kill Tony Madison Square Garden Big Joke Book, bringing together a killer lineup of up-and-coming comics who are anything but saintly. Featuring: MIKE DELISLE, KATE DRESTY, RAJA, DILLON RAKOWSKI, TRAVIS HANCOCK, CHELSEA MAJEWSKI & CORY ALBERT. One year of Thirsty Thursday Comedy. One killer lineup. One hell of a night. OCT 8 - TT: BRIAN BEAUDOIN - BRIAN ​ brings the best up & coming and national touring outlaws in comedy to the Roadhouse for his Most Wanted Comedy Show. It’s a fun rowdy rooting tooting good time featuring the best local upcoming and touring acts!! Joining BRIAN On Stage Will Be: TBA OCT 15: TT: DR. B’S CLEAN COMEDY ​- DR. B brings uplifting, family-friendly laughter to Mohegan Sun with a high-energy showcase built on positivity, connection, and community. Hosted by the charismatic Dr. B himself, the show celebrates humor without the edge—perfect for date nights, groups, and anyone looking for big laughs without going blue. Inspired by the success of Comix Roadhouse’s Thirsty Thursday clean-comedy nights, this special event continues the tradition of fun, feel-good stand-up that everyone can enjoy. Join DR. B’S CLEAN COMEDY for a night of “laughter to redemption” and discover one of the most refreshing comedy experiences around. Joining our DR. counterexamples.name: V – The Ultimate Variety Show
counterexamples.description: You do not become the best variety show in Las Vegas by being like all the others. V The Ultimate Variety Show has consistently been voted the best variety show in Las Vegas because it continues to push the boundaries and be the most innovative variety production on the Strip. Recently celebrating its 11th year on stage, V The Ultimate Variety Show, has something for everyone. From its opening at The Venetian to its current venue at V Theater, inside the Miracle Mile Shops of Planet Hollywood, V The Ultimate Variety Show has wowed audiences with its ever changing cast of incredible performers. Featuring the comedic hosting of world famous juggler Wally Eastwood to the beauty and death defying skills of the Skating Aratas, V has it all. There is no need to go see three different shows to experience the best of Las Vegas. V The Ultimate Variety Show is perfect for audiences of all ages, and it makes an excellent addition to any vacation.
